game.name: Retro Arcade Studio (All 50 Coin-Op Classics)
game.desc: 50 modernized arcade classics featuring Lode Runner, Dig Dug, Donkey Kong, Sumo, Pac-Man, Frogger, Galaga, Space Invaders, OutRun, Contra, Paperboy, Rampage, Pitfall!, Duck Hunt, Missile Command, and 35 more!

game.name: Lode Runner (1983 Irem / Brøderbund)
game.desc: Dig bricks to trap guards & collect all gold chests to reveal the escape ladder. Enhancements: 8s brick regen, WASM A* guard AI & walking on trapped guards

game.name: Dig Dug (1982 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Carve dirt tunnels, inflate Pookas & Fygars with your air pump & drop boulders. Enhancements: 4-color soil strata, 4-stage monster inflation & rock crushes

game.name: Donkey Kong (1981 Nintendo Coin-Op)
game.desc: Climb slanted steel girders, jump rolling barrels & grab hammers across 8 stages. Enhancements: 25m Girders, 50m Conveyor, 75m Elevators & 100m Rivet Tower

game.name: Sumo Arcade (1984 Technōs / Data East)
game.desc: Push, slap-stun & sidestep your rival sumo wrestler out of the circular Dohyo ring. Enhancements: Stamina friction physics & pulsing ring-edge danger tension

game.name: Pac-Man / Ms. Pac (1980 Namco / Midway)
game.desc: Eat all maze dots & power pellets to chomp Blinky, Pinky, Inky & Clyde for 1600 pts. Enhancements: 4 distinct arcade mazes, 4 ghost AI personalities & bonus fruit

game.name: Frogger (1981 Konami / Sega)
game.desc: Hop your frog across 5 lanes of speeding cars & ride floating river logs to home bays. Enhancements: Diving turtles, crocodiles, bonus flies & strict 60s life timer

game.name: Galaga (1981 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Blast diving alien bug formations & rescue your captured fighter for Dual-Ship guns. Enhancements: Boss tractor-beam capture/rescue & 4-shot Dual Fighter mode

game.name: Space Invaders (1978 Taito Coin-Op)
game.desc: Defend Earth behind 4 destructible bunkers against 55 marching alien invaders & UFOs. Enhancements: Accelerating fleet march heartbeat & pixel-eroded shields

game.name: Asteroids (1979 Atari Vector)
game.desc: Rotate & thrust your vector ship to shatter splitting boulders & UFO saucers. Enhancements: Glowing vector lines, wrap-around physics & 3-stage rock splits

game.name: Centipede (1980 Atari Coin-Op)
game.desc: Shoot the winding multi-segment centipede & spiders through a mushroom field. Enhancements: Splitting centipede chains, 4-hit mushrooms, Fleas & Scorpions

game.name: Defender (1981 Williams Coin-Op)
game.desc: Fly across a wrap-around alien planet with radar scanner to save humanoids. Enhancements: Live top radar minimap, mid-air human catches & Mutant AI

game.name: Arkanoid (1986 Taito Coin-Op)
game.desc: Bounce the energy ball off your Vaus paddle to smash 12 brick fortresses & capsules. Enhancements: [E] Expand, [M] 3-Ball Multiball, [L] Dual Lasers & [S] Slow

game.name: Paperboy (1985 Atari System 2)
game.desc: Steer your bike up the street, toss newspapers into mailboxes & dodge hazards. Enhancements: Subscriber mailboxes, breakable non-subscriber windows & dogs

game.name: Joust (1982 Williams Coin-Op)
game.desc: Flap your flying ostrich above lava & defeat buzzard riders by striking from higher up. Enhancements: Higher-lance wins, hatching eggs & grasping Lava Troll Hand

game.name: Q*bert (1982 Gottlieb Coin-Op)
game.desc: Hop diagonally across a 3D cube pyramid to flip every tile color while dodging Coily. Enhancements: Coily snake chase AI & floating escape discs on pyramid sides

game.name: Rampage (1986 Bally Midway)
game.desc: Climb skyscrapers as a giant monster & punch windows until the buildings collapse. Enhancements: Collapsing multi-story towers, helicopters, tanks & snacks

game.name: Marble Madness (1984 Atari System 1)
game.desc: Roll your marble down 10 steep 3D isometric ramp courses before the timer expires. Enhancements: 10 courses with 3D slopes, ice patches, bumpers & speed pads

game.name: Pitfall! (1982 Activision Classic)
game.desc: Swing on vines over tar pits, hop across crocodile jaws & grab jungle treasures. Enhancements: Upper jungle canopy + underground scorpion cavern paths

game.name: Duck Hunt (1984 Nintendo Vs./NES)
game.desc: Click/tap or aim the crosshair to shoot fast-flying ducks with 3 shells per wave. Enhancements: 3-shell shotgun reload, bouncing duck flight & hunting dog

game.name: Excitebike (1984 Nintendo Vs. System)
game.desc: Race your dirt bike over huge stunt ramps, pitch mid-air & manage turbo engine heat. Enhancements: Engine overheat gauge, track cooling arrows & rival bikers

game.name: Missile Command (1980 Atari Coin-Op)
game.desc: Launch counter-missiles from 3 batteries to detonate incoming warheads above 6 cities. Enhancements: Expanding blast shockwaves that chain-destroy split warheads

game.name: BurgerTime (1982 Data East Coin-Op)
game.desc: Walk across giant buns, patties & lettuce on kitchen scaffolds to drop burgers onto trays. Enhancements: Cascading burger slices & multi-floor enemy crush bonuses

game.name: Bubble Bobble (1986 Taito Coin-Op)
game.desc: Blow bubbles to trap cave monsters, pop them in chains & collect giant bonus fruit. Enhancements: 12 cave layouts, air currents & chain-pop fruit multipliers

game.name: Spy Hunter (1983 Bally Midway)
game.desc: Drive the G-6155 Interceptor at high speed, firing machine guns & dropping oil slicks. Enhancements: Dock inside the red Weapons Van for Oil & Smoke upgrades

game.name: Tron (1982 Bally Midway)
game.desc: Steer your neon light cycle at 90° angles to trap rival AI cycles behind light walls. Enhancements: Predictive raycast AI cycles & high-speed trail boxing

game.name: Track & Field (1983 Konami Coin-Op)
game.desc: Mash sprint buttons to build speed & time your launch angle across 5 Olympic events. Enhancements: 100m Dash, Long Jump, Javelin, 110m Hurdles & High Jump

game.name: OutRun (1986 Sega Super Scaler)
game.desc: Drift your red convertible at 290 km/h down branching palm-lined sunset highways. Enhancements: 3D hills & curves, tire smoke drifts & Left/Right road forks

game.name: Contra (1987 Konami Coin-Op)
game.desc: Run-and-gun across jungle bridges with 8-way aiming & 5-way Spread Shot powerups. Enhancements: Spread Shot [S], Rapid [R], Laser [L] & Fortress Wall Boss

game.name: Galaxian (1979 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Shoot convecting alien insect squadrons & Flagships diving in escort formations. Enhancements: Flagship + 2 Red Escort formation dives for 800-pt bonuses

game.name: Dig Dug II (1985 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Inflate monsters with your pump or hammer fault-line pegs to sink island chunks. Enhancements: Fracture coastal fault lines to drown multiple enemies at once

game.name: Elevator Action (1983 Taito Coin-Op)
game.desc: Ride elevators down a spy tower, steal secret files behind red doors & shoot agents. Enhancements: Shoot ceiling lamps for blackout cover & crush spies with elevators

game.name: Tapper (1983 Bally Midway)
game.desc: Slide frosty root beer mugs down 4 saloon bars to thirsty patrons & catch empties. Enhancements: 4 parallel counters, sliding empty glasses & tip bonuses

game.name: Lunar Lander (1979 Atari Vector)
game.desc: Rotate thrusters & feather your rocket burn to land gently on 2X-5X moon pads. Enhancements: Vector telemetry HUD, fuel conservation & 5X narrow crater pads

game.name: Tempest (1981 Atari Color Vector)
game.desc: Spin your yellow claw blaster around 3D neon wireframe tubes to blast Flippers. Enhancements: 12 Atari 3D vector tubes + screen-wiping Superzapper

game.name: Robotron: 2084 (1982 Williams Coin-Op)
game.desc: Blast relentless robot swarms in 8 directions while rescuing the last human family. Enhancements: Grunts, indestructible Hulks, Spheroids, Brains & 5000-pt rescues

game.name: Sinistar (1982 Williams Coin-Op)
game.desc: Mine Sinibomb crystals from planetoids before worker drones build the giant skull boss. Enhancements: 13-piece boss construction, radar scanner & Sinibomb homing blasts

game.name: Crystal Castles (1983 Atari Coin-Op)
game.desc: Guide Bentley Bear across 3D isometric castle ramps & elevators to scoop up every gem. Enhancements: Magic Hat invincibility, Honey Pots, Gem Eaters & Witch hazard

game.name: Zaxxon (1982 Sega Coin-Op)
game.desc: Fly diagonally through an isometric space fortress using your altitude gauge & shadow. Enhancements: Live altitude meter, ground shadow targeting, fuel tanks & Zaxxon Boss

game.name: Moon Patrol (1982 Irem / Williams)
game.desc: Drive a 6-wheel lunar buggy jumping craters while firing forward & upward lasers. Enhancements: Articulated 6-wheel suspension, bomb-dropping UFOs & checkpoints A-Z

game.name: Pengo (1982 Sega Coin-Op)
game.desc: Push sliding ice blocks across a frozen maze to crush Sno-Bees & align 3 diamonds. Enhancements: 10,000-pt 3-Diamond alignment jackpot & electric wall stun

game.name: Rally-X (1980 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Race through scrolling mazes using the radar to grab 10 flags & smoke-spin rival cars. Enhancements: Live right-side radar minimap, Special [S] flag multiplier & fuel gauge

game.name: Road Fighter (1984 Konami Coin-Op)
game.desc: Weave through traffic at 400 km/h, counter-steer skids & touch rainbow fuel cars. Enhancements: Narrowing bridges, oil slicks & counter-steer skid recovery physics

game.name: Flicky (1984 Sega Coin-Op)
game.desc: Lead a trailing chain of rescued yellow Piopio chicks to the exit door while dodging cats. Enhancements: Chain-rescue score multipliers & throwable flowerpots vs Tiger Cats

game.name: Mappy (1983 Namco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Bounce on color-changing trampolines to grab stolen loot & blast cats with sonic doors. Enhancements: 4-bounce trampoline color tension & microwave wave doors

game.name: Circus Charlie (1984 Konami Coin-Op)
game.desc: Jump a lion through flaming rings, walk tightropes over monkeys & hop circus balls. Enhancements: 5 classic Big Top events: Lion Rings, Tightrope, Balls, Horse & Trapeze

game.name: Battle City (1985 Namco Classic)
game.desc: Command your golden tank through brick walls to defend the Phoenix base from enemy armor. Enhancements: Destructible brick/steel walls, Star upgrades, Base Shovel & Time Freeze

game.name: Kung-Fu Master (1984 Irem / Data East)
game.desc: Battle across 5 temple floors with jump-kicks & crouch-punches to defeat dojo bosses. Enhancements: Grippers, Knife Throwers, Dragon Pots & 5 Floor Boss showdowns

game.name: Wild Gunman (1984 Nintendo Zapper)
game.desc: Wait for the outlaw’s eyes to flash "FIRE!!" then draw & shoot in milliseconds. Enhancements: Millisecond reaction timer, early-draw FOUL detection & Saloon Gang mode

game.name: Exerion (1983 Jaleco Coin-Op)
game.desc: Master gliding momentum over 3D alien terrain with Dual Slow & Single Fast cannons. Enhancements: Authentic ship momentum physics & ammo-charging Fast Cannon

game.name: Tetris & Columns (1988 Atari / 1990 Sega)
game.desc: Clear 4-line Tetrominoes or match 3-gem jewel chains in a dual-mode puzzle cabinet. Enhancements: 2-in-1 Tetris + Columns modes, ghost piece, combos & neon bursts

game.name: Rolling Thunder (1986 Namco / Atari Games)
game.desc: Leap between multi-tiered catwalks, duck into doorways for cover, and rescue Leila Blitz. Enhancements: Junko Ozawa YM2151 OST, Masker Syndicate, Bullets/Arms doors & SMG rapid fire

game.name: Golden Axe (1989 Sega Arcade)
game.desc: Choose from 3 iconic heroes (Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, Gilius), ride Bizarrians & cast screen-filling magic. Enhancements: Tohru Nakabayashi Wilderness OST, 3 Heroes, Chicken Leg & Dragon mounts, Potions & Death Adder
